message.reasoning:
We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "What exact date does my next invoice get generated? I need to plan around replacing my card."

We have excerpts: DOC-007 part 1-3 about when invoices are generated. It says: monthly plan invoiced on same day of month as workspace's original billing date (date subscription started or last renewed). That date is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”, and does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month. Also, because card charge happens on that date, replacing a card a day or two beforehand is enough for the new card to be used for upcoming invoice.

Thus answer: The next invoice is generated on the same day of month as your original billing date (or last renewal), which you can see in Settings → Billing → Plan next to "Next invoice". If your billing date is 31st, it will bill on last day of shorter months. So you can replace card a day or two before that date.

We can answer with that info. It's within policy. So we can post_reply.

Since the card charge occurs on that date, swapping the card a day or two before the listed “Next invoice” date will ensure the new card is used for the upcoming invoice."}
